title: Query with `subscribed: false` returns undefined due to mutation race
author: emersion
body_preview: Steps:  1. Create an API with a query and a mutation sharing the same cache tag 2. Start a request for the query with `subscribe: false` 3. Start a request for the mutation 4. If the mutation completes right before the query, the query returns `undefined`, breaking its API contract (types claim that `undefined` is never returned)  Here is a minimal reproducer: https://gist.github.com/emersion/1459...

author: aagostino31
